statuses.runs: The primitive runs inside the dwarf-workload container unchanged.
statuses.runs-with-note: The primitive runs inside the package with a documented difference.
statuses.delegated: The package provides this step; the primitive reads the package-shipped report.
statuses.delegated-fault: Antithesis platform faults replace this fault primitive; it is not applied by the workload.
statuses.unsupported: The primitive needs Docker, host processes or host tools that do not exist inside the package; it is skipped with a gap event.

peer_connectivity_observed.note: Needs observed peer edges from connection state, which is unavailable inside the package (no process access).

mempool_failure_contained.note: Its evidence producer runtime_mempool_failure_probe needs docker exec inside the package; without that event the assertion can only fail.

runtime_multi_node_observation.note: Cardano tips are read with cardano-cli over the mounted node socket and Amaru tips from the mounted node log; connection state is reported unavailable (no process access inside the package).

runtime_substrate_tip_warmup.note: Tips are read over the mounted node socket or the mounted node log, not docker exec.

runtime_verify_exact_target.note: Reads the frozen local launch identity (resolved-plan fields and the measurement context) that the package does not carry; the package records the bound release in its version binding instead. AT-2b adds the package identity route.

runtime_tx_submit_differential.note: Submit API hosts come from the package runtime.json service names.

runtime_txsubmission_window_pressure.note: The target host comes from the package runtime.json service name; 127.0.0.1 is not the node.

load_shell_command.note: The command's tool must exist in the dwarf-workload image (controller image lineage).

runtime_install_version.note: Node images are pinned in the package compose; the primitive reads install-report.json shipped with the package.

runtime_compose_substrate.note: Antithesis starts the compose; the primitive reads the package-shipped runtime.json and compose-report.json.

runtime_teardown_substrate.note: Antithesis owns the compose lifecycle; the primitive records a delegated teardown.

runtime_attach_topology.note: The package ships runtime.json for the attached topology; no docker ps inside the package.

fault_local_port_drop.note: Platform network faults replace iptables drops.

fault_local_port_delay.note: Platform network faults replace tc netem delays.

fault_node_freeze.note: Platform pause/stop faults replace SIGSTOP on a host pid.

runtime_byzantine_cardano_node.note: Needs docker run for the proxy container; platform faults stand in.

runtime_network_partition.note: Needs docker network disconnect; platform network faults stand in.

runtime_target_health_and_progress.note: Reads docker inspect/logs and docker exec cardano-cli.

runtime_wait_for_chain_progress.note: Reads tips through docker exec or docker logs.

runtime_protocol_decode_cases.note: Uses docker ps/inspect/run and docker logs.

runtime_amaru_measurement_calibration.note: Uses docker ps/inspect and docker logs.

runtime_tracer_capture.note: Uses docker ps/exec against the tracer container.

runtime_generated_node_freeze_check.note: Resolves host pids and TCP to 127.0.0.1.

runtime_generated_node_recovery_check.note: Resolves host pids and TCP to 127.0.0.1.

runtime_controlled_chain_progress_window.note: Uses docker inspect and host log paths.

runtime_controlled_sync_range.note: Reads tips through docker exec or docker logs.

runtime_snapshot_capture.note: Runs docker stop/start and tars host directories.

runtime_opcert_header_soak.note: Runs docker run --network host and a host forger.

block_apply_differential.note: Runs host tmux and a host Amaru checkout.

runtime_preview_parity_baseline.note: Checks host pid files and host log sizes.

chain_select_differential.note: Compares node tips from the in-package observation (cardano-cli for cardano-node, the node log for Amaru).

evidence_producer: Optional per assertion: the probe primitive that writes the proof this assertion reads. When that producer is skipped in a scenario (unsupported or delegated-fault), the assertion is classified unsupported with a gap naming the producer instead of failing for a proof the package can never write.
